summary: A D-6 cupola cabin on Horsepasture Mountain in Lane County, built in 1922 after a 1915 camp, was removed in 1965; a flat spot with metal stakes marks the summit.

facts.status_note: Cabin removed in 1965; a flat spot with metal stakes marks the summit where it stood.

access.note: Out-and-back hike from a trailhead reached by driving Highway 126 east from Eugene to McKenzie Bridge.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the Weebly history say the cabin was removed in 1965; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1965. Both agree the cabin was gone by 1965.

sources.title: History of The Willamette National Forest, photos

notes_for_editor: Date conflicts: the register and Weebly history give 1922 for the standard cabin; a Willamette history photo caption gives 1927 for a Horsepasture lookout house; the story reports the gap without resolving it. Fate: removed (register, Weebly) versus destroyed (firelookout.com), both 1965. Staffing: the 1918 and 1919-1922 entries name individual women; only Dorothy Dickey is named in the story. The Oregon Hikers guide is a current source for the summit; the hike and drive details come from it, not from a Forest Service page. Access is inferred as public from the hike guide; no Forest Service or closure notice was checked. Two web searches found no other Horsepasture source. Photos on the record (firetower.org 1962 image, Former Fire Lookout Sites Register credit) were not re-checked and are not added.
